name: trustworthy-programmatic-runtime-refactor
title: Programmatic Environment Foundry v2 Clean-Break Refactor
description: Design a clean-break five-component programmatic environment foundry: Controller coordinates Designer, Builder, Judge, and Registry to compile one request into a real package; ExpandJob reuses the same flow for revisions/new packages without training dependency; rollout/veRL stays external and optional.
creator: kelong.zx
notes: User approved the five-component clean-break implementation. Direct Generation always produces the requested first package; a non-blocking Discovery lane feeds a later budgeted ExpansionCampaign. Specialized agents require hermetic Skills/Hooks/Tools/workspaces, and evolution prioritizes tool surfaces, transition constraints, and task scope over source-code mutation. No compatibility or mock/fake/stub path is allowed.
